name: brevity-briefing
description: Write short, scannable updates in the headline, what's new, why it matters format that Axios describes in the book "Smart Brevity" (VandeHei, Allen, Schwartz, 2022) and its Axios HQ guides. Use when the user asks for an Axios-style update, a newsletter item, a skimmable team or stakeholder update, a "why it matters" summary, or an email or Slack update people will read on a phone. Pick business-writing instead for decision memos and asks that need options and a deadline.
